def test_fix_spaces():
    # no spaces
    assert fix_spaces("") == ""
    assert fix_spaces("abc") == "abc"

    # 1-2 spaces -> underscores
    assert fix_spaces("a b") == "a_b"
    assert fix_spaces("a  b") == "a__b"

    # 3+ spaces -> single hyphen (run collapses, not repeated)
    assert fix_spaces("a   b") == "a-b"
    assert fix_spaces("a     b") == "a-b"

    # leading / trailing runs
    assert fix_spaces("  a") == "__a"
    assert fix_spaces("a  ") == "a__"
    assert fix_spaces("a   ") == "a-"
    assert fix_spaces("   ") == "-"

    # mixed
    assert fix_spaces("a  b   c") == "a__b-c"
    assert fix_spaces("  hello  world  ") == "__hello__world__"
